concepts.gloss_en: Simchat Torah / the joy of Torah — here equated with the aspect of 'speech within knowledge (da'at)' (Torah 74)

members.note: representative; joy of Torah alone, glossed as דבור בדעה

concepts.gloss_en: Joy of Torah AND mitzvah — a compound construct pairing Torah with mitzvah, distinct head from 'joy of Torah' alone

members.note: different construct head (adds ומצוה); different Torah (lm2:81) and context (elevation via speech/money)

notes: Different construct heads: 'joy of Torah' vs 'joy of Torah and mitzvah'. Per rule 4, an expanded construct is a different concept. They also appear in different Torahs with unrelated proof contexts. Kept separate.
